items.raw_excerpt: A total of 3.2 million passengers used Copenhagen Airport in September, which was 4 percent more than during the same month last year, according to a press statement from the airport.

items.raw_excerpt: A house can be irresistible in August and considerably less convincing in January. In summer, the Algarve does much of the work. items.raw_excerpt: Japanese judo officials said they had never seen anything like it after eventual champion Rin Maeda appeared to be bitten by her Chinese opponent at the Asian Games. Maeda was awarded victory in the quarterfinal bout in Nagoya when Tang Jing was disqualified just over a minute into the contest.…

items.raw_excerpt: The Lady Machine kehrt beim Stone Techno Festival 2026 mit einem reinen Vinyl-Set zurück. Präzises Mixing und straff getriebene Rhythmen bilden das Fundament, ergänzt durch härtere, klassisch geprägte Tracks und melodische Wendungen. Immer wieder öffnet sich das Set Richtung Electro und 2-Step, bevor es zum Techno zurückfindet – geprägt von Vinyl-Kultur und Offenheit.
items.summary_en: The Lady Machine is coming back to the Stone Techno Festival in 2026. She will play a set using only vinyl records. Precise mixing and tight, driving rhythms form the base, and the set opens up to electro and 2-step before it returns to techno.
